label: refusalIsSuccess: a refused kernel edit still hands back the tree's layers, so a refusal can land as a step
orderFlipped: the tree's roots are built top first, so the kernel moves and arranges the wrong way
anchorShiftDropped: a drag up past layers forgets that taking the layer out shifts the anchor
copyKeepsSourceID: a duplicate's payload id wins over the node's, so the copy repeats its source's id
noOpIsAStep: an edit that leaves the order as it was still records an undo step
find: guard let next, next != layers else { return }

label: bringForwardSendsBack: Bring Forward hands the kernel the wrong arrange step, now that the kernel alone decides the edge
destinationUnchecked: a list drag to an out-of-range destination reaches the kernel, which drops the layer at the bottom
